segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ יֵין נֶסֶךְ שֶׁנָּפַל לַבּוֹר, כּוּלּוֹ אָסוּר בַּהֲנָאָה. רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אוֹמֵר: יִמָּכֵר כּוּלּוֹ לְגוֹי, חוּץ מִדְּמֵי יֵין נֶסֶךְ שֶׁבּוֹ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «wine» used for «a libation that fell into» a wine «cistern,» it is «prohibited» to derive «benefit» from «all of» the wine in the cistern, even if the volume of the wine used for a libation was tiny in comparison to the volume of the wine in the cistern. «Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says: All of the» wine in the cistern «may be sold to a gentile,» and the money paid for it is permitted «except for the value of the wine» used for «a libation» that is included «in it.»

moves.summary: The whole cistern is forbidden for benefit
All may be sold to a gentile except the libation wine's value
